# `cargo cicd publish run`

Publishes eligible workspace crates to crates.io after verifying all ALIVE release conditions are met. Emits a PublishRunEvent that the wasm4pm oracle may audit post-release.

**Noun:** `publish` &nbsp;&nbsp; **Verb:** `run`

<!-- END ggen:command-reference -->

<!-- BEGIN custom:examples -->
## Examples

```sh
cargo cicd publish run
```
